description: Each year on September 11, Fire Department personnel conduct a moving ceremony honoring those who lost their lives. There is no program, and visitors are welcome to arrive and leave as they desire.The memorial is located outside the Overland Park Fire Training Center at 12401 Hemlock and is open to the public daily.

description:
Join Leawood Parks, Recreation & Arts for the Parks for Pollinators BioBlitz - a fun and free community science event!

Using the free iNaturalist app, participants will explore Ironwoods Park while photographing and documenting local pollinators (such as plants and insects) and their habitats. The information collected provides a valuable snapshot of biodiversity and supports conservation efforts that protect these essential species.
